name: Summer Camp at Riverbend's Gladwyne Preserve
description_short: Riverbend's original weekly nature day camp on its 30 acre Gladwyne preserve for ages 5 to 13, in four age groups. Campers hike, explore the stream and ponds, meet the camp animals and build forts; ages 9 to 10 add offsite Nature Quest days, and the 11 to 13 Trailblazers lead their own projects and take a field trip each week.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 a week deposit is due at booking and is a non-refundable administration fee, as are transaction fees. Tuition balances are due in full and become non-refundable on June 1.
notes: One weekly rate of $680 for everyone. Hours 9:00 to 3:30, before care 8:00 to 9:00 and aftercare 3:30 to 6:00 (extra cost, amount not posted). Age groups: Adventurers 5 to 6, Explorers 7 to 8, Discoverers 9 to 10, Trailblazers 11 to 13 (Trailblazers run June 14 to September 3). Summer 2026 sold out; 2027 registration opens December 11, 2026 at 9 AM. The hub page shows the Gladwyne dates as 'June 7 to September 3, 2026', which looks like a typo for 2027.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Gladwyne preserve camp page: Summer 2027, ages 5 to 13, June 7 to September 3, 2027, 9:00 to 3:30 Monday to Friday, $680 per week, before and aftercare, scholarships (preference to PA ACCESS card holders), 1950 Spring Mill Road, Gladwyne, PA 19035. Exact week by week dates are not listed, so the session is the whole season with weekly enrollment. Outdoor: indoor moves only for weather or air quality.

Researched by Claude from this page. Trailblazers page (ages 11 to 13 at the same preserve, same price): leadership projects and a weekly field trip, past trips including paddleboarding, kayaking, archery and tubing.
